title: MLE5216 · Electron Spectroscopy 原理与应用

questions.prompt: Which statements correctly connect electron–matter signals with local chemical analysis?

options.text: BSE brightness alone uniquely identifies every element in an unknown specimen.
EDS and EDX denote the same technique and can provide point spectra, line scans and elemental maps.
Overlaying elemental maps with an SE image can connect local composition with surface morphology.
Returning beam electrons, emitted photons and absorbed-electron specimen current are different possible signals; EDS and WDS analyse the X-ray-photon branch.

questions.explanation:
A 错误：BSE提供与散射能力等因素有关的相对成分反差，亮度不能唯一确定元素身份。
B 正确：EDS与EDX是同一技术的不同缩写；点、线、面测量回答不同空间范围的组分问题。
C 正确：SE提供形貌，元素图提供组分分布，二者叠加可建立结构与化学的联系。
D 正确：课件区分返回的BSE、发射的光子及吸收电子形成的样品电流；阴极发光和X射线均属光子分支，但所测光谱范围不同，不能把这些信号混成同一种。

重点词：backscattered electrons（背散射电子）；elemental mapping（元素成像）；topography（形貌）。
逻辑链：电子束与样品相互作用 → 产生不同信号 → 按信号选择探测器 → 分别回答形貌、相对成分或元素身份。

questions.prompt: Which statements correctly describe characteristic X-ray production?

options.text: XRF and EDS use the same incident excitation beam because they can measure the same characteristic X-rays.
XRF uses incident X-rays, whereas EDS and WDS use energetic electrons to initiate core-level excitation.
One element can produce several characteristic lines because several allowed core-level transitions are possible.
Only allowed transitions occur; Kα and Kβ both end in the K shell but originate from different higher shells.

questions.explanation:
A 错误：相同发射线不代表激发源相同；XRF由X射线激发，EDS/WDS由电子束激发。
B 正确：两者都能产生内层空穴，随后弛豫发出特征X射线。
C 正确：不同允许跃迁有不同能级差，因此峰数不能直接等于元素数；跃迁还受选择规则限制。
D 正确：K表示接受电子的最终壳层，α和β区分较高壳层的跃迁来源。

重点词：core hole（内层空穴）；characteristic X-ray（特征X射线）；selection rule（选择规则）。
逻辑链：足够能量的入射辐射 → 内层电子被激发并留下空穴 → 高壳层电子填补 → 能级差形成元素特征光子。

questions.prompt: An automatic EDS fit gives an unlikely element and leaves a weak shoulder unexplained. Which actions are justified?

options.text: Check candidate line assignments against plausible sample chemistry and other lines from the same element.
Accept the automatic assignment unchanged because software cannot confuse overlapping lines.
Treat every visible feature as a separate element without checking whether one element has several lines.
Check peak identification and background treatment before fitting peak contributions and quantifying composition.

questions.explanation:
A 正确：谱线可能重叠，也可能有漏掉的弱峰；应结合样品背景与同元素多条谱线核对。
B 错误：课件明确展示软件误认和漏峰，人工核查是必要环节。
C 错误：单元素可产生多条线，多个元素也可叠成一个宽峰，不能按峰数直接数元素。
D 正确：鉴别错误会传递到拟合和定量；处理流程应先解决信号归属与本底。

重点词：peak identification（峰鉴别）；overlap（重叠）；background subtraction（背景扣除）。
逻辑链：观察到宽峰或肩峰 → 检查可能的重叠与弱线 → 扣除连续背景并合理拟合 → 再进行元素定量。

questions.prompt: Which statements explain the broad background beneath EDS characteristic peaks?

options.text: Fast-electron deflection and deceleration in nuclear electric fields can emit a continuum of X-ray energies.
Reabsorption can suppress the low-energy part, so the detected continuum differs from the initially emitted continuum.
The maximum of a smooth continuum is an element-specific line that identifies the same element in every sample.
The highest possible continuum photon energy is independent of the incident electron energy.

questions.explanation:
A 正确：电子以不同程度损失能量，产生连续能量分布的制动辐射，而非单一离散跃迁线。
B 正确：部分光子在逸出前被样品吸收，因而测到的连续谱形还含传播与吸收效应。
C 错误：连续背景不是元素特征线，其宽峰顶不能直接当作元素指纹。
D 错误：光子能量来自入射电子，改变束能也会改变连续谱的能量上限。

重点词：Bremsstrahlung（制动辐射）；continuum（连续谱）；reabsorption（再吸收）。
逻辑链：快电子在核电场中偏转并损失不同能量 → 发出连续X射线 → 低能光子更易被吸收 → 形成探测到的本底。

questions.prompt: Why is a weak EDS peak not sufficient evidence that an element has a low concentration?

options.text: Peak fitting removes all differences in elemental X-ray generation efficiency.
Different elements and different shell transitions can have different fluorescence yields.
Light elements can give weak signals and less reliable quantification even when they are present.
A weak or absent peak always proves that the element is absent.

questions.explanation:
A 错误：拟合可减少噪声影响，但不能自动消除不同元素或线系的物理响应差异。
B 正确：每次电离产生X射线的概率不相同，同一元素不同壳层的线也不能直接按原始峰高比较。
C 正确：课件用轻元素可用壳层较少、辐射跃迁通道有限说明其低荧光产额；弱响应使定量更困难。
D 错误：低产额、吸收、重叠或激发不足都可让元素信号不明显。

重点词：fluorescence yield（荧光产额）；core ionization（内层电离）；detection limit（检测限）。
逻辑链：电离机会相近不代表发光效率相同 → 不同产额产生不同峰强 → 弱峰不能直接等同于低浓度 → 定量前必须校正。

questions.prompt: A bulk SEM-EDS measurement is repeated at higher beam energy. Which interpretations are justified?

options.text: The chemical sampling region must become smaller whenever the nominal surface probe remains unchanged.
Higher beam energy can enlarge the interaction volume and the lateral region contributing X-rays.
X-rays generated inside the sample may be reabsorbed along their exit paths.
Quantification corrections must consider specimen response and measurement geometry, not concentration alone.

questions.explanation:
A 错误：表面探针直径不等于整个X射线产生体积的横向范围。
B 正确：较高束能通常使块体中的电子轨迹更深、更广，局部化学测量会混合更大范围的信息。
C 正确：生成深度及离开样品的路径影响吸收，因此探测谱不同于全部发射谱。
D 正确：本课ZAF方法将原子序数、吸收、荧光产额等与束能、探测几何一起纳入校正。

重点词：interaction volume（相互作用体积）；absorption（吸收）；ZAF correction（ZAF校正）。
逻辑链：束能影响电子在样品中的传播 → 改变X射线生成范围与逸出路径 → 同时影响空间定位和峰强 → 不能只改束能而忽略定量条件。

questions.prompt: How should a quantitative composition be obtained from the EDS peaks of a two-element specimen?

options.text: Correct the relative peak intensities for the different elemental responses before interpreting a concentration ratio.
Normalize the two uncorrected peak heights and regard the result as exact composition.
Use the assumption that the concentrations of the included elements sum to the whole specimen.
Use one universal correction factor for every detector geometry and every sample material.

questions.explanation:
A 正确：课件中的校正因子把强度比转换为浓度比，二者不能直接混用。
B 错误：只归一化原始峰高仍保留产额、吸收等偏差。
C 正确：比例给相对关系，二元组分和的归一化条件才确定各自份额；前提是二元模型确实适用。
D 错误：因子包含样品与测量条件，不能当作与仪器和材料无关的通用常量。

重点词：intensity ratio（强度比）；concentration ratio（浓度比）；normalization（归一化）。
逻辑链：原始峰强 → 按元素与测量条件校正 → 得到浓度比例 → 在正确的组分模型下归一化。

questions.prompt: An EDS analysis initially assumes two elements, but a third element is then identified. Which changes are necessary?

options.text: Keep the original two elements normalized to the whole sample and add the third concentration afterwards.
Include the third element in the composition model and in the total concentration used for normalization.
Assume that adding another element makes absorption and fluorescence-yield corrections unnecessary.
Use enough corrected relative-intensity information to determine the concentrations of all included elements.

questions.explanation:
A 错误：若先把两元素占满总组分，再额外添加第三元素，会造成模型不自洽。
B 正确：归一化范围必须覆盖所采用模型中的全部组分。
C 错误：多元素只是扩展模型，元素响应及基体影响并不会消失。
D 正确：需要足够的独立校正关系，再结合总组分条件，不能仅凭一个原始峰比确定所有份额。

重点词：multielement analysis（多元素分析）；matrix effects（基体效应）；normalization（归一化）。
逻辑链：识别出额外元素 → 更新组分模型及相关校正关系 → 对全部组分统一归一化 → 避免遗漏组分造成系统性偏差。

questions.prompt: A multiphase alloy has bright and dark regions in a BSE image. Which approach supports a reliable composition comparison?

options.text: Measure EDS spectra at several representative grains in each region rather than relying on brightness alone.
Assign an exact elemental composition directly from the BSE brightness of one grain.
Check reproducibility before using an average or median to summarize a measurement series.
Treat one point spectrum as proof that the entire alloy has a uniform composition.

questions.explanation:
A 正确：BSE反差可引导选点，但元素身份和组分差异应由局部能谱核实，多晶粒测量更具代表性。
B 错误：亮度是相对散射反差，不能直接给出精确组成。
C 正确：课件强调不同晶粒的重复结果可重复时再取平均或中位数。
D 错误：单点只反映对应采样区域，不能自动代表所有相和整块样品。

重点词：representative sampling（代表性取样）；reproducibility（可重复性）；local composition（局部组分）。
逻辑链：BSE发现不同区域 → 在各相进行多点EDS验证 → 检查结果是否可重复 → 再总结相之间的可靠组分差异。

questions.prompt: How does a silicon drift detector determine the energy of an incoming X-ray?

options.text: The photon deposits energy and produces electron–hole pairs in the silicon crystal.
The generated charge is related to photon energy and is collected using an applied electric field.
The central anode and electronic readout convert the collected charge into an energy-related pulse.
Every X-ray produces the same collected charge, so pulse height contains no energy information.

questions.explanation:
A 正确：X射线在硅晶体中沉积能量并产生电子–空穴对。
B 正确：能量越大产生的载流子越多，偏置电场使电子漂移至阳极。
C 正确：中央阳极及FET等读出电路测电荷，脉冲幅度携带能量信息。
D 错误：若每个事件电荷都相同，就不能由脉冲幅度进行能量色散。

重点词：electron–hole pair（电子–空穴对）；drift（漂移）；pulse height（脉冲幅度）。
逻辑链：光子沉积能量 → 产生对应数量载流子 → 电场收集电荷 → 脉冲幅度转换为X射线能量。

questions.prompt: A high EDS count rate causes pulse pile-up. Which responses follow the detector principle?

options.text: Allow for finite pulse-processing time, during which some additional events cannot be processed normally.
Assume the specimen stops emitting X-rays whenever the detector is processing a pulse.
Reduce an excessive beam current to lower the photon arrival rate and the probability of overlapping pulses.
Increase beam current to eliminate detector dead time by increasing each electron’s kinetic energy.

questions.explanation:
A 正确：处理一次事件需要时间，处理期间的额外事件可能丢失或堆积。
B 错误：死时间属于探测器读出限制，不表示样品停止产生X射线。
C 正确：减少单位时间的入射电子及光子数可降低事件重叠概率。
D 错误：束流控制到达数量，不等同于提高单电子动能，也不能消除有限处理时间。

重点词：dead time（死时间）；count rate（计数率）；pile-up（脉冲堆积）。
逻辑链：事件到达过快 → 前一脉冲尚未处理完 → 丢计数或错误合并 → 合理降低束流以改善有效采集。

questions.prompt: Which detector-design choices improve reliable EDS signal collection?

options.text: A thin window helps maintain the appropriate vacuum near the silicon crystal and prevent ice formation.
Cooling reduces thermal noise; either liquid-nitrogen or Peltier cooling can serve this purpose.
A suitable detector position and collection angle can increase the number of X-rays collected from the sample.
Moving the detector closer changes the specimen’s core-level transition energies.

questions.explanation:
A 正确：课件把薄窗与晶体处的良好真空、防结冰联系起来。
B 正确：冷却降低热噪声，两种冷却方式都体现这一目的，而非改变元素能级。
C 正确：收集几何决定能接受多少出射光子，影响信号效率。
D 错误：位置改变收集条件，不改变样品原子内层能级差。

重点词：thermal noise（热噪声）；collection angle（收集角）；detector window（探测器窗口）。
逻辑链：稳定晶体环境并冷却 → 降低结冰和噪声影响；合理收集几何 → 接收更多有用光子 → 改善测量质量。

questions.prompt: A quick elemental survey is needed, but a later measurement must separate closely spaced X-ray lines. Which comparison is appropriate?

options.text: EDS usually has higher spectral resolving power than WDS, so WDS is useful mainly for faster broad surveys.
EDS is convenient for a quick broad spectrum, while WDS can offer better line separation at the cost of slower acquisition and more demanding operation and height control.
Narrower WDS peaks automatically imply a smaller spatial interaction volume in the specimen.
Once WDS resolves a line, neither standards nor intensity corrections are needed for quantitative composition.

questions.explanation:
A 错误：课件的相对优势相反：EDS快而方便，WDS谱分辨能力更高。
B 正确：WDS顺序选波及几何要求带来速度、操作和样品高度等取舍，课件也列出其标样要求。
C 错误：谱分辨率描述能量/波长轴分离能力，不是样品空间采样范围。
D 错误：分开谱线不等于完成定量，课件仍列出WDS的标样要求，响应及吸收等强度校正也不能省略。

重点词：spectral resolution（谱分辨率）；parallel acquisition（并行采集）；standards（标样）。
逻辑链：快速多元素概览 → 选方便的EDS；相近线难分 → 考虑高谱分辨WDS → 同时接受速度、几何与定量要求的代价。

questions.prompt: Which statements describe how WDS selects and records X-rays?

options.text: A crystal selects wavelengths through the Bragg condition, so changing the crystal–detector geometry changes the accepted wavelength.
Counting at one fixed selected wavelength records the entire broad spectrum in parallel.
Different crystal spacings and multiple channels can extend the accessible lines and improve acquisition efficiency.
The detector and monochromator geometry can be ignored when the selected wavelength is changed.

questions.explanation:
A 正确：晶体衍射满足布拉格条件，Rowland圆上的几何配合使选定波长到达探测器。
B 错误：一个固定波长只贡献一个谱点，需继续改变选波条件才得到其他位置。
C 正确：不同晶体和多通道可覆盖不同线系并提高效率，但不改变基本选波逻辑。
D 错误：选波与几何本来就相互关联，不能把WDS当作与角度无关的全谱读出。

重点词：Bragg condition（布拉格条件）；monochromator（单色器）；sequential acquisition（顺序采集）。
逻辑链：选择晶体及衍射角 → 仅相应波长被有效选出 → 记录该谱点 → 改变几何继续扫描以形成光谱。

questions.prompt: A broad EDS feature may contain contributions from two elements. Which conclusions are justified?

options.text: A higher spectral-resolution WDS measurement can help separate nearby line contributions.
A single broad feature proves that only one element is present in the sampled region.
After separating lines, peak assignment, background treatment and quantitative corrections still require attention.
Separating spectral lines proves that the two elements are spatially separated within the specimen.

questions.explanation:
A 正确：课件的重叠谱对照展示WDS可改善相邻线的分离。
B 错误：不同元素的线可能在EDS中混成一个宽峰。
C 正确：分峰改善归属，不能代替其余处理和校正步骤。
D 错误：能量轴上分开不等于空间上分开；可能来自同一个采样体积。

重点词：overlapping peaks（重叠峰）；line separation（谱线分离）；spatial resolution（空间分辨率）。
逻辑链：宽谱峰可能包含多条线 → 提高谱分辨能力帮助归属 → 再处理背景和响应 → 元素空间分布仍需合适的扫描与采样尺度。

questions.prompt: Which statements explain the value and limits of spectrum imaging?

options.text: Saving a spectrum at each scan position creates spatially indexed spectral data, not a direct depth reconstruction.
Selected elemental maps can be extracted after acquisition, and local spectra can be re-examined.
Combining elemental maps with morphology can distinguish filler-rich regions from the surrounding fibres or matrix.
A colour-coded elemental map by itself determines every chemical bond and ionic state.

questions.explanation:
A 正确：数据包含扫描位置和能谱坐标，第三轴是能量或波长，不是物理深度。
B 正确：保存完整谱保留了后续选峰与核查局部信号的可能。
C 正确：课件纸张例子将纤维与填料的元素分布联系起来，重点是信息互补而非记材料配方。
D 错误：元素分布不等于全部键合或价态信息，后者可能需要EELS细结构等更合适信号。

重点词：spectrum imaging（谱像）；data cube（数据立方体）；elemental distribution（元素分布）。
逻辑链：逐点采集并保留完整能谱 → 选择元素信号并映射回位置 → 与形貌联合解读 → 不把元素图超解释为所有化学状态。

questions.prompt: An extra high-energy EDS feature becomes much stronger when the count rate is increased. Which interpretations are reasonable?

options.text: Nearly simultaneous photon events may be processed as one event carrying their combined energy.
Lowering the beam current is a useful check for a pile-up-related sum feature.
An additional peak must represent a new impurity element rather than a detector artefact.
Changing current can alter pile-up probability without changing the elemental characteristic transition energies.

questions.explanation:
A 正确：两个脉冲未能被正常分开时，收集电荷可被错误合并成较高能量事件。
B 正确：降低到达率可减少重叠；课件用不同束流的曲线展示这种诊断思路。
C 错误：额外峰可能是和峰，不能一见新峰就添加新元素。
D 正确：电流改变事件到达率，不改变元素内层能级差。

重点词：sum peak（和峰）；pulse pile-up（脉冲堆积）；arrival rate（到达率）。
逻辑链：光子到达过密 → 两事件在处理中重叠 → 被记成合并能量 → 改变计数率检查其变化，而非直接判为新元素。

questions.prompt: Which explanation correctly identifies an escape peak in a silicon EDS detector?

options.text: An X-ray generated inside the detector can escape, leaving less energy deposited than in the original photon event.
The escape peak lies above its parent because escape adds energy to the detected event.
An escape peak and a sum peak are both caused by combining two incoming sample photons.
A silicon-related detector escape feature proves that silicon is present in the specimen.

questions.explanation:
A 正确：部分能量以探测器内产生的X射线形式逸出，最终记录的沉积能量小于原光子能量。
B 错误：能量离开而非加入探测事件，所以逃逸特征位于母峰较低能量一侧。
C 错误：和峰是多个事件重叠，逃逸峰是一个事件未完全沉积能量，两者机制和方向不同。
D 错误：这里的硅来自探测器晶体，不能据此认定样品含硅。

重点词：escape peak（逃逸峰）；deposited energy（沉积能量）；detector artefact（探测伪影）。
逻辑链：原光子进入硅晶体 → 部分能量再以X射线逸出 → 留在晶体中的能量减少 → 出现母峰低能侧的逃逸特征。

questions.prompt: Changing SEM beam energy alters an EDS measurement. Which consequences should be considered?

options.text: Higher beam energy can make a previously inaccessible high-energy characteristic line possible by satisfying its excitation requirement.
Failure to observe a chosen line at low beam energy proves that the element is absent.
Higher beam energy can enlarge the lateral X-ray-generation region and reduce spatial localization in a bulk sample.
The beam setting producing the best-looking SE image must also be sufficient for every desired EDS line.

questions.explanation:
A 正确：产生内层空穴需要足够入射能量；束能过低时，即使有该元素也可能激发不出所需线。
B 错误：缺峰可能是激发条件不足，不能直接推出元素不存在。
C 正确：较高束能同时可能增大相互作用体积，让相邻区域信号混入，因此存在取舍。
D 错误：表面SE成像与内层X射线激发的最佳条件不必相同，不能只按图像漂亮程度选谱学束能。

重点词：excitation threshold（激发阈值）；interaction volume（相互作用体积）；localization（局域性）。
逻辑链：提高束能 → 更可能激发较深核心能级，同时电子传播更广 → 可测谱线增加但局部采样范围可能变大 → 按目标谱线与空间尺度共同选束能。

questions.prompt: Why is EELS normally associated with TEM or STEM rather than the conventional bulk-sample SEM described in the course?

options.text: EELS analyses the energy lost by beam electrons transmitted through a sufficiently thin specimen.
The conventional SEM geometry discussed uses thick specimens and does not provide the required transmitted-electron measurement path.
TEM and STEM can provide a transmitting specimen and an appropriate detector path below it.
EELS measures characteristic X-ray photons above the sample, so specimen transmission is irrelevant.

questions.explanation:
A 正确：EELS的被测对象是穿过样品后仍可检测的束电子及其能量损失。
B 正确：本课常规SEM的厚样品及探测几何不提供这种下方透射路径，这是老师Tutorial的核心原因。
C 正确：TEM/STEM的薄样品和透射电子光路与这一测量要求相符。
D 错误：这把EELS与EDS/WDS的X射线探测混淆，忽略了真正需要的信号路径。

重点词：transmission（透射）；energy loss（能量损失）；detector geometry（探测器几何）。
逻辑链：EELS要测穿过样品的电子 → 样品必须足够透射并有下方光路 → TEM/STEM符合条件 → 不能仅在常规厚样品SEM上加一个X射线式探测器替代。

questions.prompt: Which information can EELS provide beyond a simple list of elements?

options.text: The lecture overview includes excitation information such as phonons, plasmons and interband transitions.
Core-loss features can identify elements, while their fine structure may contain additional electronic-state information.
Changes in edge structure can support investigation of ionic valence and bonding.
EELS and EDS are not identical observables: one measures beam-electron energy loss and the other emitted X-ray photon energy.

questions.explanation:
A 正确：EELS能探测不同类型的能量转移，不仅是元素核心边。
B 正确：核心边位置与元素有关，边附近结构还可能反映局部可用电子态。
C 正确：课件利用氧化物细结构说明价态、键合等附加信息。
D 正确：两者共享某些激发背景，但探测对象及对应跃迁过程不同。

重点词：phonon（声子）；plasmon（等离激元）；fine structure（细结构）；valence（价态）。
逻辑链：电子向样品转移能量 → 不同激发对应不同能损特征 → 边位置提供元素线索、边形提供电子态线索 → 根据问题选择合适能损区段。

questions.prompt: Why can the same core excitation lead to a symmetric EDS line but an asymmetric EELS ionization edge?

options.text: EDS emission connects discrete core levels, whereas EELS excites a core electron into a distribution of available states.
The EELS edge depends only on occupied core states and is unrelated to unoccupied conduction-band states.
An EELS ionization threshold and its edge structure must be distinguished from the background before interpretation.
EELS must have the same peak shape as EDS because both measurements involve the same sample element.

questions.explanation:
A 正确：EDS特征光子对应较明确的离散能级差；EELS激发的最终空态有分布，因此形成不对称电离边。
B 错误：课件明确将边形与局部导带可用空态密度联系起来，不能只看已占据核心态。
C 正确：核心边叠加在本底上，先识别阈值并扣除背景，才可讨论细结构。
D 错误：元素相同不代表测量同一个物理量或同样的最终态分布。

重点词：discrete levels（离散能级）；ionization edge（电离边）；unoccupied states（未占据态）；density of states（态密度）。
逻辑链：EDS：离散壳层间弛豫 → 近对称特征线；EELS：核心电子进入一系列空态 → 能损分布与态密度相关 → 形成非对称边。

questions.prompt: Which interpretation of an EDS–EELS spectral comparison is justified?

options.text: The finer spectral resolution available in the illustrated EELS measurement can reveal energy structure not resolved by EDS.
EELS cannot provide element-related information because it detects electrons rather than X-ray photons.
EDS photon energy and EELS electron energy loss are the same observable produced by identical transitions.
Better spectral resolution alone guarantees finer spatial localization regardless of probe size and specimen.

questions.explanation:
A 正确：课件比较说明EELS可区分更细的能量结构，不需要记具体分辨率数值才能理解这一用途。
B 错误：核心损失边同样可提供元素信息。
C 错误：EDS测辐射弛豫光子，EELS测束电子在激发中的能量损失，不能把两条能量轴当作完全相同过程。
D 错误：能量轴的谱分辨率和样品空间定位是不同维度，后者还受探针和相互作用范围影响。

重点词：spectral resolution（谱分辨率）；spatial resolution（空间分辨率）；energy transfer（能量转移）。
逻辑链：能量结构分得更细 → 更易看见细谱特征；采样区域是否更小 → 仍需看探针与样品 → 两种分辨能力必须分别判断。

questions.prompt: Two regions contain the same transition-metal element but may have different chemical states. Which EELS arguments are justified?

options.text: Different ionic valences can produce different edge fine structures even when the elemental identity is unchanged.
All compounds containing the same element must have identical edge shapes.
Edge-shape changes can reflect changes in local available electronic states and help distinguish chemical environments.
Only the total integrated intensity can carry chemical information; edge shape is irrelevant.

questions.explanation:
A 正确：课件的氧化物对照表明同一元素的不同价态可改变边结构。
B 错误：元素身份相同不代表价态、键合和局部电子结构相同。
C 正确：边形与局部未占据态相关，可用于分析化学环境差异。
D 错误：细结构形状正是附加化学状态信息的重要来源，不能只看总计数。

重点词：ionic valence（离子价态）；bonding（键合）；local electronic structure（局部电子结构）。
逻辑链：价态或键合改变 → 局部未占据电子态改变 → EELS边细结构变化 → 用形状而非仅总强度比较化学状态。

questions.prompt: A semiconductor has spatially varying composition. Which measurements and interpretations are appropriate?

options.text: Low-loss EELS can probe excitation of valence electrons into available conduction-band states.
The onset of suitable low-loss excitations can provide a band-gap estimate.
Comparing a local EDS composition map with a local EELS gap map can investigate a composition–property relationship.
The band gap can be read directly from ordinary characteristic EDS photon counts without measuring an energy-loss spectrum.

questions.explanation:
A 正确：带隙相关低损失信号涉及价电子激发，而非深核心电子激发。
B 正确：对半导体或绝缘体，合适的激发起始可与带隙联系起来。
C 正确：课件将组分与带隙沿位置比较，体现化学组成和电子性质的互补测量。
D 错误：普通EDS主要给元素相关X射线，不直接代替低损失EELS的带隙测量。

重点词：low-loss EELS（低损失EELS）；onset（起始位置）；band gap（带隙）。
逻辑链：价带电子跃迁需要达到能隙要求 → 能损谱出现相关起始 → 提取局部带隙 → 与局部元素组成比较以研究结构/组分—性质联系。

questions.prompt: Which practical comparisons should guide a choice between EDS and EELS under the course conditions?

options.text: EDS is common, relatively convenient and automated, and can cover many elemental lines in a spectrum.
EELS requires no alignment and is always less demanding to process than EDS.
EELS can be particularly useful for light-element and chemical-state questions, while its alignment and processing requirements must be considered.
Broad EDS spectral coverage guarantees that every element is detectable at every beam energy without yield or absorption limitations.

questions.explanation:
A 正确：课件把成本、常见程度和自动化列为EDS的实用优点。
B 错误：课件指出EELS需要对准，谱处理也较费人工，不能只看它的信息优势。
C 正确：本课常规测量条件下，EELS对轻元素、过渡金属及价态键合问题有价值，但实验代价也重要。
D 错误：激发条件、荧光产额和吸收仍限制可测信号，宽谱覆盖不是无条件检测保证。

重点词：elemental coverage（元素覆盖范围）；alignment（对准）；chemical state（化学状态）。
逻辑链：先明确需要元素组成还是电子/化学状态 → 比较可获得的信息 → 再考虑样品、对准、处理及成本 → 选择合适而非名义上最强的技术。

questions.prompt: When can EDXRF be preferred to electron-beam EDS even though both detect characteristic X-rays?

options.text: When the object is sensitive to electron-beam damage.
When portable or off-site analysis is needed.
When the required measurement cannot be carried out in the electron microscope vacuum.
When the main requirement is the highly localized analysis provided by a focused STEM electron probe.

questions.explanation:
A 正确：老师教程把电子束敏感性列为选择不同激发方式的理由。
B 正确：便携、现场测量也是EDXRF的应用优势。
C 正确：样品不能进入所需真空环境时，应考虑测量约束更合适的方法。
D 错误：若主要目标是聚焦电子探针提供的高度局域谱学，应考虑合适的STEM测量；EDXRF的现场及样品兼容优势不能替代这一空间定位要求。

重点词：excitation source（激发源）；beam-sensitive（束敏感的）；portable analysis（便携分析）。
逻辑链：测量相同类型特征X射线 ≠ 激发方式和样品条件相同 → 检查电子束损伤、真空及现场限制 → 在适当场景选EDXRF而非EDS。

questions.prompt: Why is conventional EDS not obtained merely by adding an X-ray detector to an ordinary STM?

options.text: The tunnelling electrons do not have sufficient energy for the core excitation underlying the characteristic X-rays discussed.
The sharp STM tip guarantees enough core-excitation energy because it gives good spatial localization.
An X-ray detector supplies the missing excitation energy to the tunnelling electrons.
Increasing the number of low-energy tunnelling electrons automatically raises the kinetic energy of each electron.

questions.explanation:
A 正确：老师教程强调普通STM电子能量不足；关键限制是不能有效产生所需内层激发。
B 错误：空间定位好不等于入射电子能量足够，两者是不同条件。
C 错误：探测器记录已有信号，不负责补充样品激发能量。
D 错误：电子数量和单电子能量不能混为一谈，增大低能电子数不自动满足电离阈值。

重点词：core excitation（内层激发）；tunnelling electron（隧穿电子）；excitation energy（激发能量）。
逻辑链：特征X射线需要内层空穴 → 普通STM电子能量不足 → 不产生所需激发 → 只加探测器或只增加电子数不能补足这一条件。

questions.prompt: Which measurement–information matches are appropriate when combining microscopy with spectroscopy?

options.text: A fine STEM probe with a suitable thin specimen can support highly localized EDS or EELS mapping.
EDS can map elemental distribution, while EELS fine structure can add local chemical-state information.
Narrower WDS lines alone establish that neighbouring nanoscale regions are spatially resolved.
BSE can guide the selection of compositionally different regions, but spectra are needed to establish elemental identities.

questions.explanation:
A 正确：小探针及薄样品可使电子激发更局域，课件据此引出STEM中的高空间分辨谱学。
B 正确：元素分布与价态/键合是相关但不同的信息，可联合回答问题。
C 错误：WDS分开的是能量/波长相近谱线，空间上是否分开还需看采样体积与探针。
D 正确：BSE适合寻找相对组分差异，不能独自给出唯一元素身份。

重点词：localization（局域性）；complementary information（互补信息）；element identification（元素鉴别）。
逻辑链：显微反差提示值得分析的位置 → 小探针局域采集谱学信号 → 按元素或化学状态提取信息 → 分开评估空间定位与能谱分离能力。

questions.prompt: An expected EDS line is not clearly detected. Which explanations should be checked before concluding that the element is absent?

options.text: The incident beam may not supply enough energy to excite the relevant core level.
The relevant transition may have a low fluorescence yield.
Generated X-rays may be absorbed before reaching the detector.
The feature may be hidden by overlapping lines or a background that requires more careful processing.

questions.explanation:
A 正确：低于相应激发要求时，元素存在也不代表这条线会出现。
B 正确：不同跃迁产额不同，元素可能有弱响应。
C 正确：发射后还要逸出并到达探测器，传播吸收会减弱信号。
D 正确：重叠、噪声和连续本底可能掩盖弱线，需要合理处理与复核，不能直接作不存在的结论。

重点词：non-detection（未检出）；excitation threshold（激发阈值）；signal assignment（信号归属）。
逻辑链：元素存在 → 还需能被激发、产生足够辐射、成功逸出并被区分 → 任一环节受限都可缺峰 → 未检出不能自动等同于不存在。

questions.prompt: The beam remains on a small particle in a different matrix. A matrix-element EDS line becomes stronger at higher beam energy. Which interpretation is justified?

options.text: A larger X-ray-generation region may sample more of the surrounding matrix.
The intensity change proves that matrix atoms have diffused into the particle.
Keeping the surface beam position fixed guarantees an unchanged chemical sampling volume.
Switching to narrower WDS peaks alone removes any matrix contribution caused by lateral electron spreading.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：提高束能可使电子在块体中的相互作用区域变大，来自邻近基体的X射线贡献因此可能增加。B（错误）：信号增强还可由采样区域改变解释，不能仅凭此证明发生了原子扩散或真实成分变化。C（错误）：固定表面落点不代表电子在样品内部的散射范围不变。D（错误）：WDS主要改善谱线的能量分离，不能仅靠峰变窄就消除空间采样混合。

重点词：interaction volume（相互作用体积）；sampling region（采样区域）；matrix contribution（基体贡献）。
逻辑链：束能提高 → X射线产生区域可能横向扩展 → 邻近基体贡献增加；先排查采样效应，再推断真实成分变化。

source.page: Spectroscopy PDF pp.25,34–37; STEM PDF p.6

questions.prompt: Two regions show the same elements in EDS, but their bonding or ionic states may differ. Which follow-up reasoning is appropriate?

options.text: Matching elemental identities in EDS guarantees identical ionic states in both regions.
Compare the core-loss EELS edge fine structures for information about the local chemical states.
The same element can show different EELS edge shapes when its local available electronic states differ.
Any change in EELS edge shape must indicate an additional element rather than a changed chemical environment.

questions.explanation:
A（错误）：元素身份与离子价态不是同一个信息层次，相同元素可处于不同局部化学环境。B（正确）：核心损失EELS的边细结构能够提供元素身份之外的价态或键合信息。C（正确）：课件将边形与局部可用电子态联系，同一元素在不同价态下可有不同细结构。D（错误）：边形改变也可能来自同一元素的化学环境变化，不能直接当作新增元素。

重点词：elemental identity（元素身份）；edge fine structure（边细结构）；chemical state（化学状态）。
逻辑链：EDS确认有哪些元素 → 化学态问题仍可能未解决 → 检查EELS边细结构与局部可用态的变化。

source.page: Spectroscopy PDF pp.44–48; STEM PDF pp.3,7

questions.prompt: The same specimen is examined by EDXRF and electron-beam EDS. Which comparisons are physically justified?

options.text: The same characteristic transition can give the same photon energy even when the incident excitation differs.
Agreement of characteristic line positions does not require the two methods to use the same incident beam.
Raw photon intensities should not be assumed directly comparable when excitation and measurement conditions differ.
Vacuum, specimen-damage and portability constraints still matter when choosing between methods that detect similar characteristic X-rays.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：特征X射线由原子能级间跃迁产生，课件说明X射线或高能电子激发都可产生相同的特征线。B（正确）：发射线位置一致不等于激发源相同；EDXRF用入射X射线，EDS用电子束。C（正确）：激发、吸收和收集条件都影响测到的强度，不能由线位置相同就把原始峰高直接等同。D（正确）：老师Tutorial强调，便携、所需真空和电子束敏感性可决定何时选EDXRF。

重点词：excitation（激发）；characteristic emission（特征发射）；measurement conditions（测量条件）。
逻辑链：不同激发方式可产生相同核心空穴 → 相同特征跃迁可给出相同线位置 → 但强度解释与适用条件仍需分别判断。

source.page: Spectroscopy PDF pp.18,24–25,52; STEM PDF p.8

questions.prompt: An extra EDS feature is strongly count-rate dependent, and a possible silicon-detector escape feature is also present. Which distinctions are correct?

options.text: Reducing the photon arrival rate can reduce the probability that separate photon pulses overlap.
A sum feature is produced when part of a single photon event escapes from the detector.
A detector escape event can record less deposited energy without combining separate sample photons.
Neither a count-rate-related sum feature nor a detector escape feature should automatically be assigned to a new specimen element.

questions.explanation:
A（正确）：到达率下降使相近时间内的独立事件更少重叠，可减轻脉冲堆积和求和峰。B（错误）：这描述的是能量逃逸机制；求和峰来自不同光子事件被合并计数。C（正确）：逃逸峰中，一次入射事件的部分能量以探测器内部产生的X射线逃出，记录的沉积能量因此降低。D（正确）：两类特征都可能由检测过程产生，应先检查仪器伪峰再作元素赋值。

重点词：pulse pile-up（脉冲堆积）；sum peak（求和峰）；escape peak（逃逸峰）。
逻辑链：先区分多个事件叠加与单事件能量逃逸 → 用计数率变化及谱形关系检查机制 → 避免把探测器伪峰当作样品新元素。
